questions.text: What is the relationship between a chatbot and a large language model?

options.text: The chatbot is the AI itself, and the language model is just the website that hosts it.
The chatbot is a user interface; the large language model behind it is the actual AI system that processes and generates text.
They are two names for exactly the same thing.
The chatbot trains the language model a little more every time you send it a message.

questions.explanation: The lesson compares a chatbot to a phone — the device you use to communicate — while the large language model is the system on the other end that processes your input and generates the response.

questions.text: According to the lesson, which of these are things AI cannot do?

options.text: Truly understand meaning or context the way humans do
Generate human-like text in dozens of languages
Feel emotions or hold genuine opinions
Guarantee that its output is accurate
Translate between languages in real time

questions.explanation: Generating text and translating are listed among AI's real capabilities, while genuine understanding, genuine emotion and guaranteed accuracy are named as things AI cannot deliver.

questions.text: Every AI tool teachers use today is narrow AI — powerful within specific tasks, but unable to generalise the way humans do.
questions.explanation: The lesson states that all current AI tools are narrow AI, and that Artificial General Intelligence — which could handle any intellectual task a human can — does not yet exist.

questions.text: Why is the myth "AI knows everything" wrong?

options.text: AI models are trained on data up to a cutoff date and generate plausible patterns rather than knowing facts.
AI deliberately withholds information its developers consider sensitive.
AI can only answer questions that appear word-for-word somewhere in its training data.
AI stores only the topics its developers selected for it by hand.

questions.explanation: Models learn statistical patterns from data up to a training cutoff, which is exactly why they can present a fabricated citation or a wrong date with complete confidence.
